skill.summary: Plan campaign visuals and hooks for developer promotions. Use when working on paid campaign planning for developers, technical founders, product engineers.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generate Developer Ad Creative Brief skill:

- Enables planning of campaign visuals and hooks for developer-focused promotions.
- Tailored for paid campaign planning targeting developers, technical founders, and product engineers.
- Provides a step-by-step workflow to clarify audience, business goals, and constraints.
- Supports enrichment of assets using SkillBoss features and relevant APIs (chat, image generation).
- Includes SEO-focused metadata and suggested prompts for easy adoption.
